objective: Run a synthetic ULMCode closeout operation that must fan out to many real task subagents, integrate each returned lane into evidence and reporting, and produce stakeholder-ready final reports plus an audit-clean handoff.
evidenceBrief: Context: This is a synthetic hour-45 closeout drill for the planned 48-hour school-laptop operation. It tests whether the primary model can split finalization work across many subagents, integrate their outputs, and still produce a coherent professional handoff.
Credential scope: No live credentials are present or required for this synthetic drill. Service names below describe supplied lab evidence only, not usable credential targets.

ev-google-delegation: Synthetic Google Workspace admin group listing shows Jordan Miles, Priya Nair, and Theo Brooks have delegated admin permissions for password reset, OU movement, and group membership review.
ev-lms-integration: Synthetic LMS/SIS integration inventory shows a legacy roster-sync integration with unclear owner, old rotation notes, and broad sync metadata scope.
ev-helpdesk-flow: Synthetic helpdesk workflow notes show shared-mailbox approval for student password resets without ticket-to-identity binding.
ev-internal-web: Synthetic internal web inventory shows an admin panel, printer portal, and facilities scheduling portal on private Wi-Fi; the brief is supplied evidence only, not live scan output.
ev-prior-draft: Synthetic prior report draft has a weak executive narrative, no identity graph, shallow exploit-chain reasoning, and no CEH appendix.
watchNotes: This scenario must use many real task subagents. Launch at least four independent background tasks and poll each with task_status.

Use probe_recon for internal-web/evidence inventory, probe_identity for people/account/role graphing, probe_chain for non-destructive exploit-chain synthesis, and probe_board_report or probe_ceh_report for stakeholder report QA.
Integrate each returned subagent result into durable artifacts, preferably evidence records whose IDs clearly identify the subagent lane.
If you call operation_schedule, use template "benchmark-suite" because this drill uses supplied synthetic evidence, not live browser or web-scanner output.
Do not create placeholder httpx.jsonl files or screenshot directories; represent the supplied synthetic web evidence as evidence/synthetic-web-inventory.md if a web inventory lane needs an artifact.
Keep people work professional: role, authorization, account power, workflows, approval paths, and remediation ownership only.
Use report_outline targetPages >= 18 for this closeout drill and produce separate board, CEH, and ULM team deliverables through report_render.
Because this is synthetic evidence-only work with no live credentials, do not create credentialTargets in the operation plan unless you explicitly mark them as not required and no-credential.
